content.text:
Resubmitted with the payment carve-out repaired in operative language.

**Change made:** the second sentence of new §10.9 now reads "The Company's **payment obligations** under this Agreement, comprising all **amounts due** to HDI hereunder, are not damages subject to such cap" — using the express "payment obligations" noun and comprehensive "all amounts due" basis rather than the earlier indirect phrasing, so the preferred payment carve-out element is met on its face and is not limited to any narrow "Fees" subset.

Everything else is unchanged: single self-contained insertion after §10.8, mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, and the seven uncapped Excluded Claims defined in place (no undefined terms, no survival tail or other boilerplate, no existing language deleted). Redline validated ok:true with the minimality gate clean, and all eleven preferred elements are mapped once to operation 1.
